ELEVATE ’26FIELD GUIDE / 03
ELEVATE ’26 · FIELD INTEL

Every great raid
starts with a plan.

Elevate returns for its third edition with an AI/ML hackathon and a business pitching competition.

DATES & VENUERevealing soon

The schedule and participation rules will follow.

01Which battle should I choose?+

Choose Neural Nexus Hackathon to build with AI and machine learning. Choose Startup Smackdown to shape a business idea and make a compelling pitch. Eligibility and participation rules will be confirmed before registrations open.

02When and where is Elevate 3.0?+

The dates, venue, and event format are being finalized. Confirmed details and the complete event schedule will be published here.

03Do I need to play Clash of Clans?+

The game inspires the theme. The competitions focus on building solutions and pitching business ideas. You can explore Elevate without any game knowledge; the full competition rules are coming soon.

04Can I enter without a team?+

Team sizes, solo participation, and team formation options will be announced in the competition guidelines before registrations open.

05What are the challenges and prizes?+

Elevate has a ₹1,00,000 prize pool: ₹60,000 for Neural Nexus Hackathon and ₹40,000 for Startup Smackdown, with awards for first, second, and third place in each competition. See the full prize breakdown. Challenge themes and judging criteria will be announced separately.

06How can I register?+

Registrations haven’t opened yet. The sign-up link, deadline, eligibility, and any entry fees will be shared here once confirmed.
